nodes.name: Profound boredom
nodes.greek: tiefe Langeweile / es ist einem langweilig
nodes.translation: profound boredom ("it is boring for one")
nodes.definition: The impersonal third form: passing-the-time is no longer permitted, beings as a whole give a telling refusal, and the metaphysical questions open. This cluster's most-treated construct; the primary bridge target of Strand A/B (bridges to fcm-06, fcm-07).

nodes.name: Being bored by something
nodes.definition: Boredom attached to a determinate culprit (the train-station): openly fought by passing the time. In this cluster it is the form most often named and least often developed — cited as an example, rarely analyzed (bridges to fcm-04).

nodes.name: Being bored with something
nodes.definition: Boredom with no determinate culprit (the dinner-party): outward engagement and inward emptiness coexist. Mihačević argues this is the only form that is a genuine loss of *personal* meaning (bor-sec-09, pp.40-41). Bridges to fcm-05.

nodes.name: Situational versus trait boredom
nodes.definition: The psychological partition between an occurrent state and a stable disposition. Load-bearing for the cluster: Elpidorou's functional account applies to state boredom while reframing trait boredom as a dysfunction of the same mechanism (bor-sec-26, p.333 n.5). The axis on which the deficit/functional debate is resolved rather than won.

nodes.name: Boredom proneness
nodes.definition: Stable individual susceptibility to boredom, operationalized chiefly by the Boredom Proneness Scale (Farmer & Sundberg 1986) and the Zuckerman Boredom Susceptibility Scale. Elpidorou & Freeman argue profound boredom fails identification with trait boredom: both are totalizing, but trait boredom is incapacitating where profound boredom is motivating (bor-sec-04, pp.14-15, 22).

nodes.name: Mind-wandering and task-unrelated thought
nodes.definition: Off-task cognition treated as boredom's cognitive correlate or mechanism. Miyauchi & Kawasaki make it the explicit mechanism, indexing TUT by tonic frontal-temporal theta enhancement (bor-sec-29, N=15).

nodes.name: Attentional disengagement and meta-awareness
nodes.definition: The failure or withdrawal of attentional engagement, and the subject's awareness of it. The cluster's most broadly distributed construct (29 units) and the principal hinge between the phenomenological and empirical strands, since it is describable as disclosure and measurable as decrement.

nodes.name: Boredom as regulatory signal
nodes.definition: Boredom construed as informative and regulatory rather than as deficit: it signals an unsatisfactory situation and motivates goal-change (Elpidorou, bor-sec-25). The functional pole of DA-01. Heidegger's "telling refusal is a telling" is its independent phenomenological analogue (bor-sec-13).

nodes.name: Flow and engagement
nodes.definition: Boredom's contrast pole, chiefly via Csikszentmihalyi's four-channel model, in which boredom is a structural quadrant (low challenge / high skill). Nacke & Lindley build purpose-designed boredom, immersion, and flow game levels as experimental conditions (bor-sec-44).

nodes.name: Monotony and meaninglessness
nodes.definition: The environmental (repetition, sameness) and semantic (loss of significance) faces of boredom's cause. The pole-pair of DA-07: Hughes argues pandemic boredom is primarily environment-caused yet its residual significance is agent-relative — a hybrid, not an endorsement of either pole (bor-sec-08).

nodes.name: Temporality of boredom
nodes.definition: Boredom as a relation to time: the lengthening of the while. Empirically operationalized as duration-estimation error (boredom-prone individuals misjudge perceptual-event duration) and as response-time latency (Miyauchi & Kawasaki: 35.33s to key-press for boredom vs. 8.81s for dislike, uncorrelated).

nodes.name: EEG frontal alpha asymmetry
nodes.definition: Right-minus-left alpha power at homologous frontal sites (F4-F3), the approach/withdrawal motivation index. Perone et al. find no baseline trait-boredom correlation but a leftward FEA shift across a boring task among low-trait-boredom participants (r=-.48/-.47, p<.01). Seo et al. find asymmetry features rarely selected for boredom classification. Central to DA-05.

nodes.name: EEG alpha and theta power
nodes.definition: Band power in alpha (~8-13 Hz) and theta (~4-8 Hz). The cluster's most-reviewed EEG measure, anchored historically in Oswald's (1962) alpha hypothesis and the beta/(alpha+theta) engagement index. Miyauchi & Kawasaki report transient right-temporal alpha and tonic frontal-temporal theta enhancement during boredom (N=15).

nodes.name: EEG functional connectivity
nodes.definition: Inter-regional coupling rather than local band power. Yuvaraj et al. (2025) supply the cluster's only first-party connectivity study, and it is set in an educational context. Barry et al. and Seo et al. both explicitly report connectivity as not attempted, flagging it as a gap.

nodes.name: EEG eyes-open versus eyes-closed baseline
nodes.definition: The resting-state protocol question. Barry et al. establish the two conditions are not equivalent baselines, decomposing the eyes-open alpha reduction into a global arousal component (alpha, uniform, tracking skin conductance) and a topographically focal activation component (delta/theta/beta). Yuvaraj et al. use no resting baseline at all — both conditions are active eyes-open viewing — sidestepping rather than resolving the caution.

nodes.name: Pupil dilation
nodes.definition: Pupil diameter as an index of cognitive load, arousal, or affect. Scharinger et al. pair it with EEG alpha as dual load-measures. Charoenpit & Ohkura's stated boredom rule is contradicted in sign by their own correlation tables. Jaques et al. explicitly exclude pupil dilation over a luminance confound.

nodes.name: Gaze variance and fixation dispersion
nodes.definition: Spatial distribution of fixations, typically over areas of interest. Kim et al. detect boredom via lost-focus heat-map regions and AOI fixation counts (11/13 participants). Holmqvist et al. supply the reporting standard the measure should meet.

nodes.name: Blink and eye-closure
nodes.definition: Blink metrics as fatigue/disengagement index. Notably, in Perone et al. blinks appear only as an ICA artifact-correction step, never as a substantive dependent measure — an instructive case of the same signal being noise in one design and data in another.

nodes.name: Heart rate and HRV
nodes.definition: Autonomic arousal. The site of the cluster's directional-fractionation problem: London et al. (1972) report increased HR, Pattyn et al. (2008) decreased HR during a boring task, and Tam et al. report rising heart rate with falling skin conductance. Subjectively low-arousal boredom coexisting with autonomically high-arousal signatures is a core piece of DA-04.

nodes.name: Self-report scale
nodes.definition: The cluster's most widely used measure (25 units) and its most contested. Instruments: Boredom Proneness Scale (Farmer & Sundberg 1986), Zuckerman Boredom Susceptibility Scale, Multidimensional State Boredom Scale (Fahlman et al. 2013), Goetz et al. (2014) experience sampling. Kim et al. find it uncorrelated with every physiological feature they measured; Heidegger's awakening/ascertaining distinction supplies the principled reason not to treat it as ground truth. Central to DA-04.

nodes.name: Behavioral performance monitoring
nodes.definition: Reaction time, error rates, and error-related potentials. Yakobi et al. find the boredom pattern concentrated in commission (not omission) errors plus two mutually uncorrelated ERPs (P3, ERN), and argue explicitly against "a simple mechanism of reduced attention".

nodes.name: Predictive-processing model
nodes.definition: A modelling formalism rather than an instrument: boredom as prediction-error dynamics under precision-weighting. Darling is the cluster's home source, defining the apparatus and bracketing (not resolving) the dark-room objection. Distinguish sharply from ML predictive *analytics* (bor-sec-39), which is a different thing sharing a word.

nodes.name: ML classification
nodes.definition: Supervised classification of boredom from physiological features. Seo et al. supply the cluster's only validated first-party accuracy (86.73%, k-NN, two-electrode Muse, N=28); Jaques et al. report 68.83% (kappa=.330) for boredom from gaze. The cluster's caution: reported accuracies are frequently borrowed from cited companion studies rather than newly validated (bor-sec-41).

nodes.name: Regulatory theory of boredom
nodes.definition: Elpidorou's account: boredom is an emotion that is informative (signalling an unsatisfactory situation) and regulatory (motivating goal-change), with a three-part adaptive-value case and an explicit limit — boredom signals lack of interest, not lack of importance (bor-sec-25, p.473). The cluster's most-cited in-cluster theory.

nodes.name: Boredom Feedback Model
nodes.definition: Tam et al.'s model built on inadequate attentional engagement (IAE) — a discrepancy between actual and desired attentional engagement — as boredom's core, with feedback between attention and affect.

nodes.name: Goldilocks zone
nodes.definition: The band of task difficulty that avoids boredom on either side (too easy or too complex), inherited from Danckert & Elpidorou and given a formal reading in Darling's predictive-processing synthesis.

nodes.name: Four-type taxonomy of academic boredom
nodes.definition: Indifferent, calibrating, searching, reactant boredom. Feldges & Pieczenko's central critique is that the taxonomy conflates an antecedent state, a genuine core form, and resultant directed-emotion states under one label (bor-sec-16, pp.9-10).

nodes.name: Magical transformation theory of emotion
nodes.definition: Emotion as a pre-reflective magical transformation of the world. Elpidorou & Freeman's own extension applies it to boredom — Sartre never discusses boredom himself — producing a non-pathologizing functional reading via machinery incompatible with the Heideggerian one (bor-sec-05).

nodes.name: Engagement index
nodes.definition: Pope, Bogart & Bartolome's ratio formula converting band power into a scalar engagement estimate; the historical bridge from EEG spectra to an "engagement" construct, surveyed in Raffaelli et al.

nodes.name: Directional fractionation
nodes.definition: The hypothesis that subjective low arousal and autonomic high arousal can dissociate in boredom, proposed in Raffaelli et al.'s review to reconcile contradictory HR findings. The mechanism underwriting DA-04's self-report/physiology split.

nodes.name: All-Things-Considered Judgment model
nodes.translation: All-Things-Considered Judgment model of owned emotion
nodes.definition: McManus's own model of authentic (owned) emotion, offered against decisionist and standpoint rivals. Notable for the cluster: McManus treats *angst*, never boredom, as the paradigmatic authenticity-relevant Grundstimmung still owed an account — while the same volume's chapter 8 argues profound boredom deserves exactly that status (DA-10).

nodes.name: Motivation model
nodes.definition: Wang, Xu & Chen's inference-rule model mapping gaze features (average pupil diameter, fixation count) plus self-input onto motivational factors, driving personalised pedagogical-agent feedback. Its headline 81.3% accuracy is borrowed from a cited companion study, not validated in the demo paper itself.

nodes.name: Langeweile
nodes.definition: The German term whose morphology (lange Weile, "long while") carries the temporal thesis the English "boredom" loses: boredom is the lengthening of the while, not merely an unpleasant feeling.

nodes.name: Grundstimmung
nodes.definition: A mood that discloses beings as a whole; awakened, never ascertained. The cluster's pivotal term: candidate occupants are contested (angst vs. profound boredom — DA-03), as is its scale (individual vs. Volk-level — DA-08).

nodes.name: Stimmung
nodes.definition: Mood as a disclosive way of being attuned to the world, as against an inner feeling-state. The general category of which boredom is a species, and the site of the mood/emotion distinction contested in DA-09.

nodes.name: Befindlichkeit
nodes.definition: Being and Time's structure of always-already-finding-oneself-attuned. Its English rendering is itself a documented debate with at least eight competing translations (bor-sec-02, p.663 n.4). Withy reconstructs it as a disclosive structure broader than mood (bor-sec-51).

nodes.name: Leergelassenheit
nodes.definition: The first structural moment: beings' telling refusal (Versagen) of themselves. Shared across all three forms, which is Mihačević's argument that profound boredom cannot be an entirely alien form (bor-sec-09, p.39).

nodes.name: Hingehaltenheit
nodes.definition: The second structural moment: being impelled toward what makes Dasein possible. Paired with Leergelassenheit as the structural unity that is FCM's analytic payload.

nodes.name: Zeitvertreib
nodes.definition: The counter-move that drives boredom off and "drives time on". Mansikka reads the contemporary entertainment industry's continuous driving-away of boredom as foreclosing the very possibility profound boredom might open (bor-sec-18, pp.267-268).

nodes.name: Augenblick
nodes.definition: The Kierkegaardian-derived instant toward which profound boredom impels Dasein; the temporal character of being-held-in-limbo. Gibbs makes it the title concept of an educational reading (bor-sec-07).

nodes.name: Gebanntheit
nodes.definition: Being held spellbound by time's single threefold horizon; the temporal character of being-left-empty. Quaranta's "Temporal Entrancement" is her own cinematic gloss and not a citation of this term — a distinction the cluster records rather than smooths over (bor-sec-10).

nodes.name: Versagen
nodes.definition: Beings' refusal of themselves that is simultaneously a telling — the proto-functional structure in Heidegger's own text. Slaby reconstructs "telling refusal is a telling" faithfully and judges its activist payoff over-extended (bor-sec-13); Slaby & Thonhauser politicize its addressee into a Volk (bor-sec-55).

nodes.name: Dasein
nodes.definition: The entity for whom being is an issue. Its individualist construction is the cluster's live problem: Hughes shows a society-wide simultaneous withdrawal has no place in it (bor-sec-08), Slaby & Thonhauser record Heidegger's own Volk-level reframing (bor-sec-55).

nodes.name: das Man
nodes.definition: The anonymous everyone into whose averageness Dasein falls. Mansikka's pedagogical point: a student's outward engagement and success are fully compatible with governance by das Man rather than an authentic self-relation — engagement and authenticity are independent axes (bor-sec-18, p.264).

nodes.name: Gestell
nodes.definition: The technological mode of revealing that sets everything in order as standing-reserve. The organizing term of the cluster's technology-and-education sub-strand (Aroles & Küpers, Mertel, Thomson), where its homogenizing effect on curricula is the nearest analogue to monotony.

nodes.name: Bestand
nodes.definition: What enframing reduces entities to: optimizable resource. Thomson's account of students and teachers reduced to meaningless optimizable resources produces an "ontological drift toward meaninglessness" (bor-sec-19).

nodes.name: Eigentlichkeit
nodes.definition: Owning one's existence as one's own. The axis on which the cluster's sharpest intra-volume tension turns: whether angst or profound boredom is the authenticity-disclosing Grundstimmung (DA-10).

nodes.name: Paideia
nodes.definition: Education as the transformation of the soul in its entirety, recovered against the competency-accumulation model. Thomson's and Mansikka's shared pivot for reading Heidegger's ontological education.

nodes.name: Bildung
nodes.definition: Formation, set against both the 19th-century "cultivation of subjective qualities" misreading that Heidegger dismisses and the instrumental metrics model. Gibbs opposes quality-metrics education to Rortyan edification and Bildung-as-flourishing (bor-sec-07).

nodes.name: Pathos
nodes.definition: Sheehan's argument that πάθος, de-psychologized and read as facticity, is die Sache selbst of Heidegger's entire project. Drawn from the metaphysical/psychological lineage (De Anima, Metaphysics), NOT from Rhetoric II's taxonomy of persuasive emotions — a productive adjacency to the dissertation's rhetorical project, not an overlap (bor-sec-46).

nodes.name: Hedone
nodes.definition: Read by Keane, via Heidegger's 1924 Aristotle lectures, as a mode of self-having/Befindlichkeit rather than a sensation — the disclosive structure FCM later specializes into boredom's forms (bor-sec-47).

nodes.name: Kairos
nodes.definition: The right or opportune time as against chronological duration. Tömmel's love-as-passion analysis makes kairotic temporality the structural inverse of boredom's dragging chronos (bor-sec-53).

nodes.name: Enthymeme
nodes.definition: The rhetorical syllogism proceeding from endoxa rather than necessary premises. Part of Keane's reconstruction of Heidegger's rehabilitation of Aristotle's Rhetoric as "the first systematic hermeneutic" of everyday being-with-others (BT SZ 138) — high independent relevance to the dissertation's Part I (bor-sec-47).

nodes.name: Irre
nodes.definition: The turning-away constitutive of truth's double concealment. Vallega-Neu's thesis that bodily disposition is constitutive of attunement collapses any clean separation between truth-revealing and errancy-prone attunements (bor-sec-52).

nodes.name: Aletheia
nodes.definition: Truth as unconcealment, constituted by the double concealment of mystery and errancy. The frame within which Vallega-Neu locates bodily disposition (bor-sec-52).

nodes.name: Leib
nodes.definition: The lived-versus-objective body distinction. Vallega-Neu's "bodying forth" makes bodily disposition constitutive of attunement — the cluster's only sustained treatment of embodiment, and a standing gap in the otherwise disembodied Heideggerian boredom literature (bor-sec-52).

nodes.name: Volk
nodes.definition: The collective addressee onto which Slaby & Thonhauser show Heidegger reframing profound boredom's Grundstimmung, whose demand becomes collective self-founding rather than individual resoluteness — with the political entanglement that follows (bor-sec-55).

nodes.name: Formal indication
nodes.definition: Heidegger's methodological device by which a concept points toward a phenomenon to be enacted rather than defining it for external verification. Elpidorou & Freeman identify it as Heidegger's explicit resistance to having his concepts checked against empirical psychology — and proceed to check anyway, arguing the check is legitimate (bor-sec-04, p.16). The formal statement of the measurement wall.

nodes.name: Awakening not ascertaining
nodes.definition: The methodological claim that a fundamental attunement must be let-become-wakeful rather than established as present-at-hand. Hadjioannou makes the structurally identical argument for angst: reflective access distorts the affect it targets (bor-sec-48). The cluster's principled reason that self-report is not a neutral instrument. Bridges to fcm-03.

nodes.name: Minimal reporting guideline
nodes.definition: Holmqvist et al.'s empirically grounded standard for what an eye-tracking study must report (sampling rate, calibration procedure, apparatus specification, fixation-detection algorithm). The cluster's methodological authority for any Part III eye-tracking work; it also documents that VR-integrated trackers have measurably worse precision and 45-81ms added latency versus glasses-based trackers (bor-sec-36).

nodes.name: Deficit versus functional boredom
nodes.definition: DA-01. Whether boredom is a failure state or an adaptive regulatory signal. Resolved by partition rather than verdict: state boredom functional, trait boredom a dysfunction of the same mechanism (bor-sec-26). See debate-map.md.

nodes.name: Is profound boredom boredom
nodes.translation: profound boredom is boredom <-> a distinct existential mood
nodes.definition: DA-02. Whether FCM's third form is continuous with ordinary boredom or sui generis. Elpidorou & Freeman construct the sui-generis reading and reject it, landing on a qualified continuity (bor-sec-04); Mihačević stakes a middle position (bor-sec-09). See debate-map.md.

nodes.name: Angst versus boredom as Grundstimmung
nodes.translation: angst <-> profound boredom as the ground attunement
nodes.definition: DA-03. Which mood occupies the disclosive ground role. Flagged in Elpidorou & Freeman (bor-sec-02, p.662 n.2), unresolved in McManus, who never raises boredom as a candidate (bor-sec-50), and answered for boredom by Withy (bor-sec-51). See debate-map.md.

nodes.name: Self-report versus physiological ground truth
nodes.translation: self-report <-> physiological marker as ground truth
nodes.definition: DA-04. Which measure adjudicates when they disagree. Sharpened by Kim et al.'s null correlation (bor-sec-28) and Raffaelli et al.'s directional-fractionation hypothesis (bor-sec-21); given a principled basis by the awakening/ascertaining distinction. The cluster's most consequential axis for Part III. See debate-map.md.

nodes.name: Frontal asymmetry marker versus arousal confound
nodes.definition: DA-05. Whether frontal alpha asymmetry indexes boredom or general arousal. Constructed by the cluster from three units that never cite one another on the point (bor-sec-30, bor-sec-27, bor-sec-31). See debate-map.md.

nodes.name: Unified versus heterogeneous boredom
nodes.translation: boredom as unified construct <-> heterogeneous family
nodes.definition: DA-06. Whether "boredom" names one thing or many. Raffaelli et al. stay diagnostic, treating field-wide inconsistency as compatible with either non-standardized operationalization or genuine subtype heterogeneity, while committing to taxonomy as the forward path (bor-sec-21); Darling dissolves rather than adjudicates it (bor-sec-20). See debate-map.md.

nodes.name: Monotony versus meaning causation
nodes.definition: DA-07. Whether boredom is caused from outside by a determinate boring thing or arises from Dasein itself. Staged unresolved in Heidegger's own first-versus-later-forms asymmetry (bor-sec-03); Hughes lands on a hybrid (bor-sec-08). See debate-map.md.

nodes.name: Individual versus collective attunement
nodes.definition: DA-08. Whether boredom's phenomenology presupposes an individual withdrawing against an absorbed background. Hughes shows the individualist framework has no place for simultaneous society-wide withdrawal (bor-sec-08); Slaby & Thonhauser document Heidegger's own Volk-level reframing (bor-sec-55). Directly consequential for cohort-level Part III designs. See debate-map.md.
